summary: Fixed the place-uniqueness gate so documentary videos (Craze & Crash) are checked against recent videos, wrote 5 video verdicts and the first picture tallies, and re-raised the owner items lost with the deleted Paisa Panchayat folder. The data audit hadn't landed yet tonight, so the dashboard-vs-YouTube check was skipped.
why: renderer/craft.py compared only `directed` beats' places, and every Craze & Crash beat is `doc`, so its videos skipped a uniqueness check; fixed with a test that fails on the old code. No shipped video trips the fixed check.
